newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine bank treasurers set new meet today.
newsitem.headline: Philippine bank treasurers set new meet today.

text.p: The Bankers Association of the Philippines said on Tuesday it had set another meeting with bank treasurers at 5:00 p.m. today (0900 GMT).
It did not say what specific topics were to be tackled. A similar meeting was called on Monday where treasurers discussed issues related to foreign exchange market.

The peso has been depreciating steadily since Friday after the central bank announced on Friday it would let the peso move The central bank had hoped its move would eventually douse off speculation on the peso, which had been perceived as overvalued like the Thai baht.
